Markets.title: US Stock Market Live Updates: US stocks future edge lower after AI selloff, telecom slide
Markets.summary: US stock futures edged lower following a market selloff driven by artificial intelligence and telecommunication stocks. Investors responded to recent declines within these key technology and telecom sectors.

Markets.title: India's 10-year bond falls for 10th week in record slump
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds have suffered a record ten-week decline, marking their worst drop in thirty years. Rising crude oil prices, a hawkish central bank, and a benchmark repo rate hike to 5.5% have driven this broader trend of increasing yields.

Markets.title: Infosys ADRs crash 6% after Q2 results as revenue guidance cut spooks investors
Markets.summary: Infosys ADRs fell 6.3% after the company lowered its fiscal year 2027 revenue growth guidance to 1-2% and reported second-quarter profits that missed expectations. Despite beating revenue estimates for the September quarter, cautious technology spending and a lowered outlook spooked investors.

Markets.title: Market wrap: Eternal, Apollo Hospital, Shriram Finance, Adani Enterprises among top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Friday
Markets.summary: Indian equity markets fell for the fourth consecutive session on Friday, with the Nifty 50 closing at 22,600 and the Sensex at 73,123.83. Small-cap, mid-cap, and metal stocks slumped due to bearish technical signals that heightened concerns about further selling pressure.

Markets.title: Jio IPO becomes first public issue globally to cross 1 crore applications; record puts spotlight on depth of India’s retail investor base
Markets.summary: Jio Platforms received over one crore applications for its upcoming initial public offering, marking a global first for a public issue. This record-breaking surge highlights the expanding depth and enthusiasm of India's retail investor base ahead of the October 28 debut.

Markets.title: AI stocks: Midterm elections could threaten AI trade as data center backlash grows
Markets.summary: Growing public opposition and upcoming midterm elections threaten US AI infrastructure investments due to potential regulatory scrutiny and construction delays. These challenges could pressure technology stocks, utilities, and power companies despite continued strong spending on artificial intelligence.

Geo-Political.title: Ukraine says Starlink still restricted after Trump says limits lifted
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian sources report that Starlink military connections remain restricted despite Donald Trump's claim that limits were lifted. Officials previously denied intentionally slowing down the network used by Ukraine's armed forces.

Geo-Political.title: Two Israeli soldiers killed in attack by suspected Palestinian gunmen in West Bank
Geo-Political.summary: Two Israeli soldiers were killed in a West Bank shooting near Hebron by suspected Palestinian gunmen. The two attackers were subsequently shot dead by security forces four days before Israel's general election.

Geo-Political.title: Seven shot dead by gunmen at church funeral in Jordan, state media say
Geo-Political.summary: Gunmen killed seven people and injured ten others at a church funeral in Jordan's southern Karak governorate. State media reported that a manhunt for the attackers is currently underway.

Geo-Political.title: Cyprus police open investigation into financial affairs of Roman Abramovich
Geo-Political.summary: Cyprus police have launched an investigation into the financial affairs of billionaire Roman Abramovich. This follows concerns raised earlier this month regarding the integrity of some of his professional advisers.

Geo-Political.title: Denmark to ban mink farming in government U-turn
Geo-Political.summary: Denmark's government has reversed its previous stance to implement a complete ban on mink farming. The country was formerly the world's largest producer of mink pelts, though its industry had already experienced a decline in recent years.

Data & Insights.summary: India's private sector activity reached a four-month high in October due to faster manufacturing and services growth and cooling inflation. Despite this expansion, employment growth slowed to its weakest pace of the year.

Data & Insights.summary: Taxing the top one percent alone is insufficient to resolve income inequality, as the effectiveness of government spending is also crucial. Unjust social institutions and laws must be reformed or abolished to achieve true social justice.

Data & Insights.summary: India's oil imports from the Middle East returned to pre-war levels in September. Refiners increased spot cargo purchases as shipments through the Strait of Hormuz increased following the Iran war.

Data & Insights.title: The story of India’s post-election defection wave since 2022, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: Between 2022 and 2026, over 100 Indian lawmakers exploited legal loopholes in the anti-defection law to switch political parties. The National Democratic Alliance (NDA) emerged as the primary beneficiary of this defection wave across central and state levels.

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC Minutes: Governor Sanjay Malhotra ties future hikes to growth-inflation outlook — here is what he said
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that future interest rate hikes will depend on the evolving growth and inflation outlook. Policymakers shared differing views on how to balance controlling inflation without unnecessarily restricting economic activity.

Data & Insights.title: RBI MPC minutes reveal 2 members opposed shift from neutral stance to calibrated tightening in October meeting
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India raised its repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% with unanimous support from all six monetary policy committee members. While four members backed a shift to a calibrated tightening stance, two members preferred maintaining a neutral stance.
